tools.name: find_practices
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a doctor for medical weight loss or an AMITA practice in Germany. Returns the nearest AMITA practices with address, doctor, distance and next free time; locationFound is false when no place was recognised. Not for medical advice, prescriptions or emergencies.

tools.name: list_free_slots
tools.description: Use this when the person wants appointment times at one AMITA practice. Returns its free consultation times for the next two weeks (Europe/Berlin).

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Use this when the person has chosen a practice and time and wants to book. Books the non-binding first consultation with a doctor with the person's own name, e-mail and phone number and their agreement to AMITA's privacy policy; AMITA e-mails the confirmation. Cannot change or cancel an appointment.
